input: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production (scheduled routine; full brief in prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md)
task: Deepen (flagship 7) photo-editing: directional Bayer demosaic (RW2 RawFormat 8 was the first pick; its sample host was proxy-refused)
errors: raw.pixls.us refused by the session's egress proxy (connect_rejected), so the flagship's first buildable item (RW2 RawFormat 8, GH6-era files) could not be started; pivoted to the Bayer demosaic, which needs only GitHub-hosted samples.
A wait loop `until ! ps aux | grep -q '[b]ayer_demosaic_check'` matched its own command line (the heredoc imported that module) and hung for 10 minutes; stopped and reran without it.

First draft of the eval note had three claims the rows did not support (median losses 7 vs 8 of 10; 'every LibRaw method leaves more false colour on all six noisy truths' was five of six; simple red/blue range); caught by a script over the jsonl before commit and corrected.

doc_friction.issue: photo-editing's buildable line said raw.pixls.us 'serves files with curl -L'; in this session the proxy refused the host outright, so the top buildable item was not buildable. Rewritten to say proxy-refused 2026-11-15.

About 20 test files assert numpy == pure-Python bytes using DevelopSettings defaults, so any change to a numpy-only default (here demosaic='auto') fails 128 subtests at once; they now pin demosaic='bilinear'. A shared helper for 'the settings both engines share' would avoid this next time.

deviations.why: The listed first item (RW2 RawFormat 8) needed a host the proxy refused; took the 'Bayer, still bilinear' open item from the X-Trans eval note instead.
deviations.did: Built and measured a directional Bayer demosaic and made it the numpy default.
deviations.result: Landed: +0.25 to +14 dB over bilinear on six truths, best colour PSNR among LibRaw's seven Bayer methods on five of six.

goal: Deepen a flagship with a hard engineering slice: demosaic quality for nearly every camera's raw files.
notes: Verification: full photo-editing unittest suite with numpy: Ran 1168 tests in 77.120s, OK (7 skipped); tests/test_bayer_demosaic.py 9 new tests; check_post_frontmatter, check_post_links, post_similarity clean; portfolio/router/validate.py clean; node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs photo-editing: 'preflight clean for photo-editing'. Measurements: tools/bayer_demosaic_check.py on 5 real frames (Canon 70D, Nikon D810 tuning; Sony A7 III, Olympus E-M10, Pentax K-1 II held out) from drewnoakes/metadata-extractor-images plus the synthetic sheet, against LibRaw 0.22.2 linear/VNG/PPG/AHD/DCB/DHT/AAHD; rows in eval/bayer-directional-demosaic-2026-11-15.jsonl.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a senior imaging engineer implementing and benchmarking a Bayer demosaic against LibRaw on real frames, with tests and write-up: about three days
